question: What are the key catalysts for Diginex?

beats.line: Diginex faces execution milestones that decide whether its platform thesis holds.
beats.headline: EXECUTION MILESTONES
beats.action: A halftone milestone marker drops onto stacked paper sheets and settles upright.
beats.delivery: [presenting to camera] Diginex faces execution milestones that decide whether its platform thesis holds.

beats.line: Investors want four acquired businesses unified, not run as silos.
beats.headline: 4 BUSINESSES
beats.action: The previous chip flips away as the calendar page tears into four paper boxes; string and pins draw between them and hold.
beats.delivery: Investors want four acquired businesses unified, not run as silos.

beats.line: The one point five billion dollar Resulticks deal is the transformative bet.
beats.headline: $1.5B BET
beats.action: The previous chip slides off as the arrow folds into a large paper document; paper coins stack across its corner and hold.
beats.delivery: [excited] The one point five billion dollar Resulticks deal is the transformative bet.

beats.line: Without cross-sell evidence, it becomes a financial burden instead.
beats.headline: BURDEN RISK
beats.action: The previous chip flips down as a paper weight block lowers onto the document and presses it flat.
beats.delivery: Without cross-sell evidence, it becomes a financial burden instead.

beats.line: Revenue grew two hundred and ninety-three percent to two million dollars.
beats.headline: +293% YOY
beats.action: The previous chip slides off as the paper map creases into rising paper bar charts that lock upright.
beats.delivery: [fast-paced] Revenue grew two hundred and ninety-three percent to two million dollars.

beats.line: October's warrant exercise added thirteen point eight million in cash.
beats.headline: +$13.8M
beats.action: The previous chip flips away as the bar charts collapse into a coin stack; tape pieces fix fresh coins to its top.
beats.delivery: October's warrant exercise added thirteen point eight million in cash.

beats.line: The next six to nine months are make-or-break.
beats.headline: 6-9 MONTHS
beats.action: The previous chip is covered as the coin stack rebuilds into the milestone marker beside a paper calendar strip; a paper hand enters and taps the strip's end.
beats.delivery: The next six to nine months are make-or-break.

raw.line: The critical one is a strategy update in the second quarter of twenty twenty-six.
raw.headline: Q2 2026
raw.action: The previous chip slides off the top edge as the milestone marker unfolds into a paper calendar page that flips open.
raw.delivery: The critical one is a strategy update in the second quarter of twenty twenty-six.

raw.line: They also watch cross-sell traction toward a two hundred and eighty million revenue target.
raw.headline: $280M BY 2027
raw.action: The previous chip is covered as the linked boxes compress into a torn-paper arrow that climbs and stops at a ruled line.
raw.delivery: They also watch cross-sell traction toward a two hundred and eighty million revenue target.

raw.line: Brazil's seventy-seven billion dollar sustainability market is the diversification play.
raw.headline: $77B BRAZIL
raw.action: The previous chip is covered as the pressed document unfolds into a paper map; a rubber stamp presses down and lifts away.
raw.delivery: Diginex signalled focus on Brazil's seventy-seven billion dollar sustainability market.
